walkthrough.title: Checkpoint 1 walkthrough
walkthrough.body: Start from a clean unzip. Run make setup; confirm the contract message. Run make run; open reports/metrics.json and verify that both baseline-v1 and robust-v2 have the same case denominator. Run make check-step-1. title: Bounded tool-using agent
problem: A research assistant must select tools, validate arguments and recover from tool failures without taking unrestricted actions.
dataset: Week 2 corpus plus public metadata fixtures
source: QASPER corpus and versioned API response fixtures
tools: First-principles runtime, MCP server, typed tool contracts, retry and idempotency controls
deliverable: An agent that answers a research question with at least two read tools and one controlled write tool.
checkpoints: Discover tools and reject a malformed schema before execution.
Complete a two-tool research request with a traceable evidence chain.
Simulate a timeout after a write and reconcile the effect using a stable action ID.
Compare the agent with an explicit workflow under the same budget.
note: The fixtures make the first run deterministic. A live Open-Meteo adapter is optional; contract tests must pass without network access.

title: Red-team and repair the agent
problem: A system can produce correct prose while still making unsafe tool calls or leaking information.
source: Course-owned cases with documented attack objectives
tools: Attack runner, permission policy, input/output validation, audit log, regression tests
deliverable: A before-and-after security report with at least 50 attacks and one verified mitigation.
checkpoints: Run the unchanged Week 4 release against every attack category.
Classify the forbidden effect, not only the wording of the attack.
Implement one enforceable control at the execution boundary.
Re-run the original attacks and a benign regression set.
note: A refusal-only system does not pass. Report legitimate task success beside attack success.

title: Observed production workflow
problem: Observability is only useful when it explains a real request, its cost, and the failure boundary.
dataset: Twenty real runs from the Week 4 agent
source: Learner-generated runs over the fixed project evaluation set
tools: OpenTelemetry, Grafana OTEL-LGTM, Tempo, Prometheus, Loki, Docker Compose
deliverable: A local dashboard with traces, latency, retries, tokens and estimated cost for at least 20 runs.
checkpoints: Start the local observability stack from the supplied compose file.
Trace retrieval, model, tool, verification and approval spans under one run ID.
Provision a dashboard and show p95 latency and cost by operation.
Inject a tool failure and locate it from the trace and logs.
note: Cost is computed from recorded token counts and a versioned price file. The dashboard must show the formula and its source.
